title: bridge_claim_taken_over event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. AUTH-BINDING-BRIDGE-001: --takeover of a bridge binding. Distinct from claim_taken_over (worktree-shaped, worktree_name required). Prior owner audit mirrors the worktree discipline: a stale heartbeat is NOT abandonment; takeover is explicit. The bridge entry also carries a durable prior_owners array.

last_seen.description: Null when the prior binding carried no last_seen.

reason.description: Mandatory takeover rationale (same discipline as worktree seizure).
